Additional comments:

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I took both undergraduate levels 1, 2, and 3. Generally, I found it easier than in Denmark

questions.answer: Many assignments during the semester which all counts in the final grade. Furthermore, most of my tutorials required attendance of 80%

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: I found it easy because the culture in Melbourne reminds me a lot of the one in Copenhagen.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Most Australians are very welcoming and easy to talk to. They are very curios on the Danish culture

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Driving in the left side

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Australians are very helpful and genuinely want to get to know someone.

Semester starts in July and ends in November
